name: workspace
description: Convert STL mesh files into layered LEGO brick models with images, optional PDF instructions, and a 3D STL of the brick assembly. #LEGO #Architecture #Sculpture #Art ## Features - Upload `.stl` and choose processing options   - Number of layers and slicing direction (`X`, `Y`, `Z`)   - Make model hollow (shell extraction)   - Overlay previous layer for visual context   - Color bricks by shape   - Generate PDF assembly instructions   - Remove hanging bricks (non-hollow): ensures each brick has support below - Outputs   - Per-layer PNGs with grid and brick outlines   - Optional PDF instruction booklet   - Brick-assembled 3D model `.stl`
